product.title: Product Description
product.intro: aulycMail is a lightweight desktop e-mail client for people who want to manage multiple mailboxes locally in one place.
product.positionBody: The product focuses on local control, clear reading, efficient actions, and privacy protection for everyday e-mail. aulycMail does not provide e-mail hosting, cloud storage, or mail-provider services.
product.featureAccounts: Connect and synchronize multiple mail accounts through IMAP and SMTP
product.featureMail: Compose, reply to, and forward messages while managing attachments and folders
product.featureSearch: Build a local index and search mail quickly
product.featureContacts: Use local contacts and previously used addresses for recipient completion
product.featurePrivacy: Control remote-image loading to reduce tracking and privacy risks
product.featureBackup: Export mail as standard .eml files and retain synchronization and backup logs
product.dataBody: The application communicates directly with the mail providers you configure. Messages, indexes, contacts, settings, and logs stay on your device; passwords and app-specific passwords are stored in the system keychain and do not pass through aulyc servers.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro:
Last updated: July 11, 2026

aulycMail does not operate servers that collect, store, or process your mail data. Your information stays on your device except when the application communicates directly with the mail providers you configure.
privacy.noCollectionPersonal: We do not collect personal information on external servers
privacy.noCollectionMail: We do not receive your messages, contacts, or account credentials
privacy.noCollectionTracking: We do not use analytics, telemetry, or advertising tracking
privacy.noCollectionSale: We do not sell or share user data
privacy.localMail: Synchronized messages, folder metadata, local search indexes, attachments, and drafts
privacy.localAccount: Mail-account configuration; passwords and app-specific passwords stay in the system keychain
privacy.localContacts: Contacts you create and addresses collected locally from sent mail
privacy.localSettings: Theme, window state, and other application preferences
privacy.localLogs: Synchronization and backup log metadata; logs do not contain message bodies, attachments, or credentials
privacy.localBackups: Standard .eml backup files and indexes in directories you select
privacy.securityBody: Security depends on your device, the system keychain, and TLS/SSL connections to your mail providers. aulycMail connects only to IMAP/SMTP services you configure; those services are governed by their own terms and privacy policies.
privacy.retentionBody: Data remains on your device until you delete it. Uninstalling the application may leave local mail data in its application-support directory. Logs can be cleared in Settings and are limited to 30 days and the newest 1,000 entries by default. Exported backups remain in the directory you selected.
privacy.contactBody: This policy may be updated as the product changes. Contact: xaulyc@gmail.com

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro:
Last updated: July 27, 2026

By downloading, installing, or using aulycMail, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the application.
